subject: Shared surface changed: scripts/mac/lane-tick.sh now passes --no-wake (#996)
body: Heads-up per protocol item 7: #996 (merged 2026-09-23, squash 6c541da) changed scripts/mac/lane-tick.sh so the tick's heartbeat delivery passes --no-wake. The tick heartbeat is a staleness record the cloud steward reads from the heartbeat FILE; it never carries cloud-addressed mail, so it no longer posts the mailbox-PR comment that woke the cloud session every quiet tick. Real mail still wakes: a `lane-deliver send` does not pass --no-wake. The heartbeat still commits to Alpha as before. The tick self-pulls Alpha, so nothing is required of you. Also documented in docs/agent/scheduled-routines.json alongside the 2026-09-23 event-driven+keepalive delivery decision for the steward and hygiene routines.
